role: Test runner (make test-coverage; ci.yml tests job when scope != gates) that runs xcodebuild test with coverage, retries once when every failure is a simulator-infrastructure failure, then runs check_coverage.sh.
state: env:SCHEME, PROJECT, RESULT_BUNDLE (build/TestResults.xcresult), MIN_COVERAGE, TEST_SCOPE (unit|full), DESTINATION, MAX_TEST_WORKERS (3), MAX_SIM_CLONES (1), PARALLEL_TESTING (NO), TEST_DERIVED_DATA
mem:INFRA_MARKERS (the four simulator-infrastructure log strings, an ERE alternation)
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; sources lib/preflight.sh and lib/xcodebuild.sh (no cd). TEST_SCOPE: unit -> -only-testing:EmuquTests and exports SKIP_OVERALL_COVERAGE=1/SKIP_LOGIC_COVERAGE=1 (overall and logic floors reported, not gated; the Views floor still applies); full -> all targets; other -> exit 64. DESTINATION from select_simulator_destination.sh if unset (the else branch assigns DESTINATION to itself, a no-op). rm -rf result bundle. TYPE_CHECK_FLAGS add -warn-long-expression-type-checking=4000 / -warn-long-function-bodies=6000 via OTHER_SWIFT_FLAGS. INFRA_MARKERS = 'Application failed preflight checks|Failed to get matching snapshots|process main thread busy|Unknown application display identifier'. Loop (max 2 attempts): run_tests; status 0 -> break; else counts `Test [Cc]ase '...' failed` lines, counts INFRA_MARKERS lines, and collects unexplained_failures. If attempt<2 and a marker is present but some failed test is unexplained -> prints that it is not retrying and lists those tests, then exits with the status. If attempt<2, a marker is present and every failed test (or none) is explained -> `xcrun simctl shutdown all`, sleep 10, rm bundle, retries the whole run. Otherwise exits with the status. After success runs check_coverage.sh <bundle> [MIN_COVERAGE]. Comments at 79-93 say MAX_SIM_CLONES 'stops cloning', while 95-102 say that flag has nothing to do with clones and PARALLEL_TESTING=NO is the real lever; both flags are still passed.

units.does: Runs `xcodebuild test` with "$XCODEBUILD_PINNED" (packages held to the committed Package.resolved), project/scheme/destination/result bundle, parallel-testing flag, worker and destination caps, optional -only-testing and -derivedDataPath, extra type-check OTHER_SWIFT_FLAGS and code coverage, tee'ing to $TEST_LOG; returns xcodebuild's exit status.

Given an xcodebuild log, prints (one per line, deduplicated, sorted) each failed test case — the name inside `Test [Cc]ase '<name>' failed` — whose failure the infrastructure markers do not explain. A failed test is explained only when the log has at least one XCTest issue line naming it (`error: <name> :`) and every such line matches INFRA_MARKERS. A failed test with no issue line (a crash or timeout), with any issue line lacking a marker, or whose name does not appear in issue lines (another log format) is printed. Prints nothing when no test case failed or all are explained. Always returns 0 (`|| true` on the greps).

branches.cond: the failed test has no `error: <name> :` issue line, or one of its issue lines does not match INFRA_MARKERS
branches.effect: prints the test name (an unexplained failure); otherwise prints nothing for it
